PROJECT SPOOKY

A developer disappeared while working on this game. The only thing he left behind was an unfinished build.

Álvaro Llorente was creating Project Spooky, a horror game set in Casa da Fonte and built around the stories of those who passed through it.

Some time later, his files reached Team 237, a small independent studio dedicated to investigating, documenting and recovering unfinished, abandoned or unreleased videogames.

This is what we managed to reconstruct.

Project Spooky is a first-person psychological horror experience divided into seven chapters. Explore its spaces, reconstruct events through objects, sounds and documents, and discover puzzles and hidden secrets that will make you question everything that happened at Casa da Fonte.

Combat is not a gameplay system. The experience focuses on exploration, observation and interpretation.

FEAR DOESN'T APPEAR. IT IS CONSTRUCTED.

Each chapter presents an independent situation and a different mechanic.

A mirror may show you something that does not exist outside its reflection.

Sound may guide you towards something you have never seen.

Light may protect you... until you understand what it is really keeping away.

And the same house may not always be the same house.

You do not need to understand everything in order to move forward.

You probably should not try.

Features

  • First-person psychological horror.

  • Seven chapters built around different horror mechanics.

  • Puzzles based on observation, interpretation and discovery.

  • Environmental storytelling through objects, documents and spaces.

  • Environments whose logic may change between chapters.

  • Sound design as a fundamental part of the experience.

  • Full voice acting in Spanish and English.

  • A story about unfinished videogames, missing authors and our need to find meaning where there may be none.

You're not playing Project Spooky. 

You're playing what's left of it.

BUILD YOUR FACTORY

Welcome to the heavy metal industry.

Start small and work your way up. Gather materials, forge complex components, and assemble mechs to sell for massive profits.

What starts as manual work becomes a highly optimized manufacturing operation. Unlock advanced automation, grow your production, and build the perfect, infinitely efficient production line.

FORGE MECH PARTS BY HAND

Each mech is made up of individual parts.
Head. Core. Arms. Legs. Weapons.
Forge them yourself through hands-on workstation minigames, get the process down, then automate it.

HARVEST RESOURCES FROM PLANETS

Your factory needs materials, and materials have to come from somewhere.

Unlock many planets, each producing a different resource. Upgrade their extraction operations and build a steady supply of everything your manufacturing empire needs.

DESIGN YOUR OWN MECHS

Build machines that reflect your brand.
Mix and match components from different product lines, use custom finishes and save your best money making combinations as Blueprints. Preview your prototypes in the bay before sending them to the factory floor.


COMMAND THE ASSEMBLY LINE

Take control of three separate assembly lines and make hundreds of tactical production decisions. Assemble standard series, custom blueprints, or take on specialized faction orders. Do the heavy lifting up front, step back and watch your fully automated factory print money while you chase the next big contract.

WORK WITH THE FACTIONS

When you're cleared, you'll be working with clients who have very different needs.

Some want specific parts. Some want full mechs. Others give you a set of requirements and leave you to design, build, and sell the perfect machine for a serious profit.

Learn what each faction wants,, meet their demands, and turn their contracts into your biggest opportunities. The more you know your clients, the more you can make from them.

MAKE THE MARKET WORK FOR YOU

In a fast moving marketplace, you can buy and sell parts, mechs, blueprints and resources.

Watch the prices go up and down. Buy supplies while they are cheap, and sell your mechs at peak profit margins. Once you know the system, automate your buying and selling.

Project TITAN

Start with scrap, and forge your way to creating the most extraordinary mech ever conceived. Grow your wealth, expand your factory, master the art of mech manufacturing, and pour everything you've earned into one final project: TITAN.

A rhythm game that plays with time and emotion.
Follow the beat on a rotating clock and restore fractured moments across distant worlds.

🕰️ About This Game

Project YH is a story-driven rhythm game themed around “time.”

Three girls, known as “Tuners,” travel across different planets to mend distorted timelines.

Each world represents a unique emotion,
and players experience these stories through rhythm and music.

This is more than just a score-based rhythm game—
it’s an immersive journey where music and emotion intertwine.

🎧 Features

🎵 Intuitive Rhythm Gameplay

Match the timing of rotating clock hands with simple one or two key inputs.
Easy to learn, yet deeply satisfying.

✨ Stylized Visual Effects & Customization

Customize your experience with dynamic visual effects such as bloom,
camera motion, and color transitions.

🌌 Emotion-Driven Storytelling

Each planet tells a short but meaningful story,
creating a larger emotional journey as you progress.

🛠️ Level Editor & Custom Content

Create your own stages, effects, and experiences
with an easy-to-use editor and share them with others.

🌐 Online Multiplayer

Compete with other players and enjoy various multiplayer modes.

🎯 Recommended For

  • Players who enjoy emotional, music-driven experiences

  • Casual rhythm game fans looking for something unique

  • Creators who want to build and share custom content

You're one of thousands of biologists working for The Company, a megacorp obsessed with immortality. Your assignment starts at a retro terminal: run cellular simulations and search for the key to keeping a cell alive forever.

Move your cursor over glucose to attack automatically. Break it down to fuel the cell and earn ATP for your next upgrades.

Keep breaking glucose before the timer runs out to push your multiplier higher. A longer combo means more ATP to spend when the cycle ends.

Experiment with glucose types, proteins, and lipids. Try different combinations in your search for cellular immortality.

Review your results, spend the ATP you earned, and launch your next simulation with new upgrades. Each cycle brings new ways to push your experiments further.

Explore a massive skill tree and mix upgrades from different branches. Focus on your favorite approach or try a different build for your next experiment.

PropAlive is an asymmetrical 4v1 hide-and-seek game in the PROPHUNT genre, where the survivors have unique abilities and the maniacs are ancient Demons or Entities from various mythologies.

MANIACS

  • Each maniac has its own unique abilities and perks

  • Choose a cursed Тotem that will create more darkness and chaos in the gameplay when activated

WHAT SHOULD SURVIVORS DO?

  • Fix 5 generators, find the key, and supply power to the exit doors

  • Forget about the classic skill check when fixing a generator:

    The random skill check system will keep you focused. The key is not to lose your mind from the stress!

    Be careful! A failed skill check can be fatal!

TURN INTO PROPs

Mask yourself as any object on the map and trick the maniac

UNIQUE ABILITIES OF THE SURVIVORS

  • Each survivor has their own unique abilities - teleport, shield, clairvoyance, barriers, and more

  • By combining abilities with perks, you can create the best strategy for each character

PLAY HOWEVER YOU LIKE

🌗 RANKED SEASONAL SHOWDOWN BETWEEN THE FORCES OF LIGHT AND DARKNESS

  • Climb the ranks, battle worthy opponents and prove that you are the one who deserves the top spot on the leaderboard. Every season brings a new chance to become a legend and win great rewards!

  • Every battle brings one side closer to victory. Choose Light or Darkness, fight for your faction and influence the outcome of the seasonal conflict. Only the most united and powerful will be able to change the course of history.

  • Choose your side. Claim victory. Leave your mark on the world’s history. THE FATE OF THE WORLD IS IN YOUR HANDS!

⚔️ HONE YOUR SKILLS IN NORMAL MATCHES

  • Experiment with tactics, get to know the heroes and refine your playstyle without any extra pressure.

🎮 LOBBY WITH FRIENDS

  • Gather your friends, stage wild battles, set up matches on your own terms and simply enjoy the game.

BATTLEPASS, SKINS, EVENTS, and much more will also be waiting for you in our game!

Come on in, because the forces of evil are always on the move!

Deep in the Mariana Trench, a laboratory pulled a living cell up out of the abyss.

It learned. It adapted.

Then it escaped.

That cell is you.

In PROTOCELL, you will find no weapon lying on the ground and no ready-made equipment. Everything you need has to grow directly out of your own organism.

Mutate. Adapt. Survive.

But every mutation has a price.

SURVIVE THE SWARM

The principle is simple: you move, your cell attacks automatically.

Your job is to keep moving, to avoid the creatures gradually flooding the screen, and to build your organism as the game goes on.

Levels come one after another quickly, and every step up in power asks you to choose a new mutation capable of transforming the way you play.

If you enjoy the escalating power and the frenzy of Vampire Survivors or Brotato, you will find your bearings quickly. But in PROTOCELL, every upgrade genuinely transforms your organism — and the more powerful you become, the closer you get to breaking point.

EVERY MUTATION IS A RISK

Projectiles, orbiting drones, auras, shields, regeneration and many more possibilities: 52 mutations let you build your cell exactly as you see fit.

Push some mutations to their limit and they can fuse to give birth to one of the 18 evolutions, each with its own mechanic.

But your organism was not designed to withstand infinite power.

Every mutation raises your INSTABILITY.

Cross the critical threshold and you will trigger a MELTDOWN: you will then have only twenty seconds before your cell explodes.

It is up to you to decide how far you are willing to push your organism.

Play it safe…

or attempt one mutation too many.

YOUR CELL IS UNIQUE

Every protocell has its own 64-bit genetic code.

Silhouette, membrane, nucleus, appendages, colours and animation details are all determined directly by that genome.

The result: billions of possible combinations, and creatures generated and animated in real time.

And yet that genome fits into just 16 characters.

Particularly fond of one of your cells? Copy its code from your collection and share it.

Another player can enter the exact same genome in their own laboratory and recreate the same creature, with the same appearance and the same name.

Someone shares a code online? A few seconds later, that cell can grow in your own laboratory.

So your creations are not only unique.

They can travel.

EXPLORE THE DEPTHS

Your descent will take you through 8 worlds, each with its own creatures, hazards, environmental mechanics and boss.

Corrosion, freeze, burning zones, creatures able to come back to life…

Every environment imposes its own rules and forces you to adapt your organism.

And when you think you have reached the bottom, the Primordial Abyss will still be waiting.

A separate expedition of 100 floors split across 10 layers, each sealed by an exclusive boss you will meet nowhere else.

Your progress and the DNA you harvest are kept between attempts, letting you gradually prepare your next descent.

GROW YOUR LABORATORY

Between two expeditions, back to the laboratory.

Use the DNA you recovered to create new protocells, cross-breed them across 5 ranks, develop each one through a 41-node DNA tree and prepare genome recipes that can be triggered in the middle of a game.

Also take on the ancestral Hosts to recover their organelles and gear up your colony.

And if you make it all the way to the final world, The Host, the adventure does not simply stop on a victory screen.

PROTOCELL has a real conclusion, with a playable multi-act epilogue, credits and a final scene.

A COMPLETE GAME THAT WILL KEEP EVOLVING

PROTOCELL is a complete game, built to be played from the beginning through to its true ending.

I do not want to build a game around the promise of what it might become one day: the main content is already here.

But that does not mean I intend to stop.

I develop PROTOCELL alone, and I want to keep making it grow after release: new mutations, new creatures, new challenges and new depths to explore.

The game is complete today.

And I hope it will be even richer tomorrow.

DEVELOPED SOLO, WITH YOU

PROTOCELL is my game, but I also want it to evolve with the people who play it.

There are no layers between your feedback and the person developing the game: that person is me.

If you find a boss frustrating, a mutation uninteresting, an interface that could be clearer, or if you simply have an idea you would like to see in the game, tell me.

I read the feedback, I talk with players and, when an idea genuinely improves the game, I can work on it directly.

So PROTOCELL will keep evolving with its community.

ALSO

  • Fully playable with a controller or a keyboard

  • Xbox and PlayStation controller icons and prompts

  • Built-in Codex: game guide, mutation atlas and bestiary

  • Procedural creatures generated and animated in real time

  • Dozens of missions

  • 41 achievements, including a Platinum

  • Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Russian

Awaken your inner speedrunner in this challenging 2D platformer. Strategically combine routes, abilities, and artifacts, choose which obstacles to destroy, and execute every action with precision to maximize your wealth and endure until the end. Die, repeat, and evolve in pursuit of the perfect run.

 

Uncover the System

You have been recruited to explore the System, the last hope of a world on the brink of collapse. Drawn by the promise of wealth, embark on a journey filled with discoveries, challenges, and decisions that will shape your fate.

 

Throw Your Wealth

Fire coins to destroy obstacles and forge your path forward. Every throw is a strategic choice: it costs part of your wealth, but it could mean the difference between survival and death.

 

Build Your Echo Setup

Combine abilities left behind by those who came before you in the System, adapting your playstyle to master each route as efficiently as possible.

 

Define Your Spirit

Choose the Spirit that best complements your strategy to maximize your wealth. But remember: your choices will leave their mark.

 

Pursue the Perfect Run

Every move matters. The System tracks every aspect of your performance. Refine your strategy, perfect your execution, and achieve the perfect run.

"The Prowlers Shift Archive Museum needs a watchman. Badly."

You got the job. Prowlers Shift is a 2.5D comedy sim set in a cutaway museum where every room, every visitor and every bad idea is on screen at once. You can see everything. You just can't be in two places at the same time.

A new ban every morning

Yesterday the director mistook cigarette smoke for a ghost, so today tobacco is banned. Tomorrow he argues with a leek in his dream and loses. Every day brings a new decree, and someone always breaks it. When a word turns red, a rule was broken: click it and send a notice. Get it right and you earn money and Standing. Get it wrong and you pay the fine.

Everyone has a bag

Visitors check their bags at the door, and you're the one minding them. The zipper gets louder the faster you pull it. As the old watchman puts it: what you take, you carry. What you shouldn't take, someone notices.

Low wages, plenty of side jobs

  • Run errands for the staff, from three teas for the office to a missing lighthouse sock.
  • Sell half-price tickets to visitors who "forgot" to buy one.
  • Buy tea at Felix's stall. In this museum, tea is the real currency.
  • Try the Most Courteous Scratch Cards.

Not every trade is licensed, and not every table takes just anyone. Do the right favor for the right person and you'll find out.


Clock out, count up

Every shift ends with a report: what you pocketed, what you owe, tomorrow's wages and bills, and a stamp that tells you exactly what management thinks of you.

People remember

Go through someone's bag and they'll bring it up. Give someone a gift and they'll remember that too. Standing and Disrepute rise and fall with everything you do. Disrepute builds quietly; rummage loudly and it builds loudly. Let your Standing hit the floor and you're dismissed.

After closing

When the doors lock, the museum turns into something else: doors to check, someone walking the halls who shouldn't be, and a night when the lights go out.

"A delivery is coming this week. Nobody asks questions. You don't ask either. Thank you for not asking." (the Chairman, on the phone)

Features

  • A cutaway museum of 45 rooms, plus the street outside and the sewer below, all on screen at once
  • A new absurd decree every day, and red words to catch
  • Checked bags, a noisy zipper and things you probably shouldn't take
  • Errands, bootleg tickets, scratch cards, and a few businesses that only open for those who earn them
  • Standing and Disrepute: two numbers that decide whether you keep the job
  • Characters who remember what you did to them
  • A hand-written story with several endings, including a few ways to get fired early
  • Fully localized in 8 languages: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Arabic and Simplified Chinese

Eight minutes early is nearly rude. Don't be late.

Plan then Run

Every monster sleeps with an alarm clock, and the number printed on it is the moment it wakes. Drop a few monsters onto the board, choose their numbers, then press run and watch the whole board count down from 5 to 1.

Hit Every Goal

Three kinds of goal: a box on a plate, a bullet on target, a beam held in place.

Plan Wisely

Same board, same monsters - one number apart, Failed on one side and Cleared on the other.

Meet The Monsters

It All Comes Together

Later boards fill up with monsters, and one countdown has to walk every one of them through in the order you wrote.

Punk Vampires is a prequel to the novel of the same name by Jacob Cabrera.

The game puts you in the role of Chloe Wade, a young woman from New York who is bitten in 1899 by a master vampire. In this universe, when a victim is bitten, their soul leaves the body, and a creature from the Shadow Realm takes over the empty vessel.

But something unusual happens to Chloe... When the creature awakens inside her body, it carries memories, emotions, and fragments of the young woman she once was. Chloe’s soul has not crossed the threshold: for some inexplicable reason, it remains bound to the mind of the beast, coexisting with it.

At first, the creature rejects this human presence. It feels tormented by it and refuses to listen to that irritating voice inside its mind, a voice that denies it the pleasures of vampiric existence. But little by little, Chloe’s memories begin to influence its instincts, forcing the beast to confront human morality.

Can a human soul change a monster?

Punk Vampires is not just a story about punk aesthetics. The title comes from Chloe’s main conflict, tied to the noise, chaos, and rebellion of the punk movement: the perfect cover for vampires to hide their plans in the shadows.

Explore different eras, fight supernatural enemies, make decisions, overcome skill-based minigames, and discover the origin of a vampire divided between the humanity she lost and the creature that awakened in her place.

Play as exclusive characters such as Aiden Brennan in 10th-century Ireland, Missy, the hunter from London, and other protagonists within this dark, violent, and emotional story.

A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm!

Purrfect Beats is a minimalist pixel art rhythm game where a kitty is on a mission to lead their human band to stardom. Hit the drum pad at exactly the right moment, follow increasingly complex rhythms, and everything will fall into place.

No experience with rhythm or reading musical notes? No worries! Every level includes a tutorial that intuitively teaches a new rhythmic concept: quarter notes, eighth notes, sixteenth notes, triplets, and rests in all their variations. You'll be learning sight-reading and basic music theory without even realizing it.

  • Handcrafted musical levels: Every level is built around its song, with rhythms and patterns fully integrated into the music itself.

  • Simple, progressive gameplay: Each level introduces a new rhythm in an accessible and gradual way.

  • A charming protagonist: Join this adorable kitty and their drumpad on a journey to become a music star.

  • Master your timing: Achieve perfect combos in every song.

Welcome to the night shift.

Purrfect Bliss is a trendy cat cafe with a terrifying secret. Your job is simple: serve the late-night regulars, brew coffee, and take care of the cafe’s four cats.

But as the hours tick by, the cozy atmosphere shifts into something much darker. The shadows play tricks on you, the strict rules left by management feel increasingly sinister, and the cats are starting to act very strangely.

Can you survive the night shift?

Key Features

  • Barista mechanics: Prepare and serve coffee to your customers.

  • Psychological horror: An intense, escalating horror experience that will leave you on edge.

  • Immersive environment: Atmospheric graphics that pull you directly into the nightmare.

  • Four unique cats: Care for the four cats, but keep a close eye on them. Their increasingly bizarre actions suggest they are more than just ordinary pets.

  • Environmental mystery: Find hidden clues around the cafe to uncover its dark history.

A charming pixel cat is moving onto your desktop!

Your cat wanders across the screen above your windows while you work or study, naps beside the cursor, asks for a snack, and perks up whenever you play together. Over time, they develop habits, favorite things, and a personality of their own-making them a delight to watch and care for.

Personality and habits

Your cat remembers their favorite food, toy, and spot on the screen. Their mood changes too: playful today, sleepy tomorrow, or a little hurt if ignored for too long. As time passes, their character comes through-some love naps, some stay up at night, and some are always thinking about food. Cats dream, share their thoughts in little bubbles, and follow a routine of their own. No two cats turn out quite alike.

Every cat has a character of their own. Depending on how you care for them, your cat becomes a Night Owl, a Foodie, a Sleepyhead, or something else, and each trait shows in what they do. Every cat is also born with two quirks, such as watching the edge of the screen, guarding a toy, or dancing more often, and has one food they don't like until they get used to it. They remember being woken up or carried around too much and go off to sulk in a corner, stalk their toys and pounce, get startled by a sudden flick of the cursor, and are livelier in the morning and evening.

Sometimes your cat just isn't in the mood to play: they might feel lazy, get fussy, or avoid petting. These traits are temporary, and food, water, and sleep always come before entertainment.

Make them your own

Name your cat and choose their coat. The shop is packed with outfits for five cosmetic slots: headwear, face decorations, collars, tail accessories, and fur patterns. Put together any look you like, from a modest bow to a golden crown.

A life of their own

Your cat decides what to do next: stroll across the screen, dash around, rub against the cursor, or simply sit and watch the world. Their choice depends on their habits and current mood. If they settle somewhere inconvenient, gently pick them up with the mouse. You can also give them a dedicated part of the screen, keeping important windows out of paw's reach.

On Windows, your cat can settle on the edge of a window, rub against an icon, or tap it with a paw. They notice reading, typing, moving windows, and dragged files, recognize many games in the active window, and sometimes share a thought about what you're doing. You can turn these reactions off.

Care and companionship

Your cat has four needs: food, water, sleep, and love. Choose from dozens of meals and drinks, including kibble, chicken, fish, cake, milk, and juice. They eat only what they need and save the rest for later. Love grows through every bit of attention-playing, brushing, and everyday care. When tired, your cat heads to bed and drifts off. You can even move a sleeping cat together with their bed without waking them.

You can also pet your cat: hold the cursor over them and gently move the mouse back and forth. Just don't overdo it, or they'll let you know they've had enough.

The menu also includes baozi, sushi, pineapple pie, different teas, beer, and sake. Alcohol makes your cat briefly tipsy, chatty, and a little unsteady. Too much alcohol, fatty food, or sweets can lead to temporary unhealthy habits, so mix up those treats.

Toys and playtime

Give your cat a ball and watch them chase it all over the screen. Tempt them with a feather wand as they track, aim, and swat. Add a scratching post to keep their claws in shape, or treat them to a good brushing-cats love it.

Drop your cat into the Cat Wheel and they'll start running, earning coins. Set the Wind-up Mouse loose and watch the chase begin, or switch on the Laser Pointer and let them hunt the dot. The Desk Bell brings a rhythm minigame: your cat rings a tune, and you tap the same rhythm back.

Let your cat splash in the bathtub, put them on a skateboard, or play tic-tac-toe with them or a friend online. Over time, your cat rides with more confidence, steers around obstacles, and tries tricks. As their intelligence grows, they become a trickier opponent at the board.

Create a cozy home

Customize the bowl, bed, scratching post, litter box, ball, and wand, with dozens of designs for every item. A race-car bed, a palm-tree scratching post, a neon lounger, a glowing bowl… Build the perfect little corner, then let your cat choose their favorite bed.

Toys have their own looks, too: turn the wind-up mouse into a mint-colored toy car or choose a different color for the butterfly.

A little cleaning up

Cats will be cats: sometimes they scratch where they shouldn't or leave a small surprise behind. A litter box and scratching post help, but now and then you will need to tidy up yourself. Cleaning, like every other act of care, earns coins.

Chests and artifacts

A happy cat may occasionally bring home a gift chest containing coins, treats, rare outfits, or-if luck is on your side-an artifact. There are 16 artifacts across four rarities, each granting a useful bonus. Some come with a twist: a stronger benefit paired with a small drawback. Equip up to four at once.

Coins and shops

Feeding, playing, brushing, and cleaning all earn coins. Spend them in four shops offering food, home furnishings, cat outfits, and interior decorations. There is a huge collection to save up for.

Co-op

Every cat has a permanent code - share it with another player and connect to visit one another. While you’re the guest, you can settle in and try out what’s around, and the host’s cat watches you with curiosity, remembering you.

During a visit, you can pet your friend's cat, the two cats play together, and one can run in the Cat Wheel while the other watches.

Up to three cats at once

Each cat has their own name, coat, wardrobe, habits, and personality. The desktop is even livelier with three.

Your cats visit each other, rub against each other, and play chase.

Flexible settings

Adjust cat and interface size, need decay, volume, meow frequency, and roaming area. The game is available in many languages and rests quietly in the system tray without getting in your way.

For streaming, you can use an opaque background or choose your own wallpaper. On Windows, the game can also launch when your computer starts.

Steam Achievements

Unlock Steam Achievements as you care for your cat, play together, and explore everything Purrtopia has to offer.

Games and activities develop your cat's strength, agility, endurance, intelligence, and perception. Compare their progress with other players on the attribute leaderboards.

And much more to come!

We will keep expanding the selection of items, minigames, habits, and artifacts while listening closely to ideas and feedback from our community.

Your cat is waiting for your love!

Swap gems continuously, build combos, and use relics to push your score higher.

Puzzlogue is a roguelike match-3 puzzle game where you can continuously swap gems during a single move.

Plan your route within the time limit, create multiple matches, and combine combos with powerful relic effects to reach the target score.

A Match-3 Puzzle with Continuous Gem Swapping

Unlike traditional match-3 games, where you swap only two adjacent gems, Puzzlogue lets you move a selected gem continuously across the board during a single turn.

Plan your route carefully and create several matches before time runs out. The more combos you make, the higher your multiplier becomes, allowing you to earn even more points.

Combine Relics and Create Your Build

Relics provide a wide variety of effects. Some strengthen specific gem colors, some reward large combos, and others activate when gems are matched in particular shapes.

Study the properties of each relic, combine their effects, and build a strategy of your own.

Special Effects Change the Rules of the Puzzle

Some relics alter gem appearance rates, add special effects to gems, or even change the conditions required to create a match.

Focus on a single color, build around long combo chains, or aim for specific match shapes. The relics you choose will determine which strategies are most effective.

Shops and Stage Selection

As you progress, you can obtain new relics and consumable items from shops and stage rewards.

Choose your next stage from several options, each with different effects and rewards. Compare what your current build needs with the risks and rewards of each stage before deciding which path to take.

Clear the Stages with a Different Build Each Run

The relics, items, and stages available to you change with every run.

Combine the effects you find along the way and create a build capable of reaching the target score. Failure sends you back to the beginning, but each new run gives you another chance to discover different combinations and strategies.

Key Features

- A route-planning match-3 puzzle system with continuous gem swapping
- Score attack gameplay built around combos and multipliers
- Build creation using a wide variety of relics
- Special effects that change matching rules and board conditions
- Stage progression based on choosing between different effects and rewards
- Different relics, items, and strategies in every run

Two buttons. A quarter mile. Three-tenths of a second between you and the other car.


Hold the throttle. Watch the tree — three ambers, then green. Leave a hair early and
it is a red light and the run is over. Leave late and you have given away the race
before you have moved a foot.

Then it is just the shifts. Every engine has a band where the next gear starts pulling
harder than the one you are in, and the light on your tacho is pointing at it. Take it
there and the car keeps pulling. Take it early or hold it too long and you pay, every
time, on the clock.

The car is doing something under all that


Grip is not a number that gets added to your speed. The tyres have a real slip curve,
the clutch is a torque capacity that can overwhelm them, and weight moves onto the rear
axle as you pull — which is why a drag car hooks harder the harder it pulls, and why
lighting the tyres off the line costs you the run.

You will feel it before you read about it: too many revs on the line and the car goes
up in smoke, too few and it bogs. Somewhere between is your best sixty-foot, and it is
different for every car you own.

Earn it, spend it, go faster


  • Twenty-three cars across six classes, from a tired hatchback to a nitro rail.
  • Five upgrade slots — engine, forced induction, transmission, tyres, weight — and every rung of every ladder is worth real time on the clock.
  • A tuning bench that matters: launch RPM, tyre pressures, individual gear ratios, final drive.
  • Ten strips, each with its own light — high desert noon, industrial dusk, neon midnight.
  • Paint your car and take it down the strip.

A weekly run, against yourself


A spec car on a spec track, chosen by the week. Your rival is your own best ghost from
that week — the exact run you made, played back beside you. It resets every Monday and
it is generated from the calendar, so there is no server to go dark and nothing to log
in to.

What is not in it


No online. No in-game currency you can buy. No daily login, no season pass, no timers,
nothing that pings you. You buy it, you own it, and it works on a plane.

Built for it


  • Full controller support — the whole game is two buttons and a menu cursor.
  • Keyboard, and every menu reachable without a mouse.
  • Windows, macOS and Linux/SteamOS, one native build each.
  • Deterministic simulation at a fixed 120 Hz, so a run is the same run whatever your frame rate.

Quarterheart is a cozy arcade roguelite about an old machine in the attic that still works — and slowly becomes yours.

Querni is a board game for two players that combines easy-to-learn mechanics with deep tactical planning. Each player has 16 numbered tiles from 1 to 16 arranged on a 7x10 board.

Your goal is clear: be the first to remove all 16 tiles of your color from the board. But to achieve this, you must calculate every move and create numerical chains before your opponent.

Key Game Mechanics

  • Form consecutive chains: To remove tiles, you must connect a sequence of at least 3 consecutive numbers (e.g., 4, 5, 6) on adjacent squares, either sharing a side or a corner.

  • Movement and jumping: On your turn, you can move to an adjacent square or execute spectacular chained jumps over any tile (your own or your opponent's) that could allow you to cross the board in a single turn.

  • Turn strategy: On each turn, you can move a tile, remove a formed chain, do both in that order, or pass your turn without doing anything.

Victory and Defeat Conditions

  • Victory: Successfully remove all 16 of your tiles from the board.

  • Avoid orphan tiles: You cannot leave isolated tiles that are no longer able to form valid chains.

  • Passing turns: If you cannot move or remove tiles, you lose your turn. If 30 turns pass without any chain removals, the game ends in a draw.

EVOLVE AT YOUR OWN PACE

RabbitDice never forces you to reset on a timer. Keep building, evolve, or begin again. The choice is yours.

Play the free demo on Windows and macOS, and wishlist RabbitDice to follow the journey back to the Moon!

“Rabbits Hunt 2” is a point-and-click exploration horror game set in an old Japanese house.

As a member of “Rabbit Hunters,” an organization that investigates malevolent rabbit spirits and supernatural phenomena, the player visits a certain house alongside their partner, Loppy.

Rumor has it that a family suicide took place there eight years ago.

However, as you examine the traces left behind, it gradually becomes clear that a different truth lies hidden behind that incident.

This is an exploration-based horror game that progresses through “investigation” rather than combat.

Click on suspicious spots, keep an eye out for changes, and follow the memories and supernatural phenomena left behind in the house.

In the demo, you can explore “Outside the House,” where the story begins.

The eerie sense of unease lingering in front of the entrance, the dark foyer visible through the peephole, and the supernatural phenomena that seem to test anyone who approaches the house.

Silent terror, a stifling atmosphere, and sudden supernatural occurrences.

Recommended for fans of J-horror set in traditional Japanese houses, escape games, and point-and-click adventures.

*“Racketeering activity is defined as specified criminal acts, including murder, arson, distribution of controlled substances, and intimidation and retaliation against witnesses.”*

- Federal Bureau of Investigation

Racketeering is an open-world criminal sandbox where you start with nothing and build an underground empire by hand, alone or with friends.

Grow weed, harvest crops, process raw materials, package product, and sell to an expanding network of buyers. Every part of your operation is physical. Carry supplies, place equipment, organize production rooms, load setups into vehicles, and relocate when the pressure gets too close.

As your money and reputation grow, invest in better equipment, vehicles, properties, and legitimate businesses. Expand beyond weed into party drugs, meth, and cocaine. Launder your profits, manage police attention, navigate rival gangs, and decide how far you are willing to go to protect everything you have built.


Control the entire operation from production to sale. Cultivate crops, process materials, manufacture increasingly valuable products, package your supply, and build a reliable network of buyers.


Your operation exists in the world, not just in menus. Carry equipment, position workstations, arrange production rooms, stock vehicles, and physically build every stage of your empire.



RUN THE OPERATION TOGETHER

Build alone or work alongside friends in online co-op. Divide responsibilities, combine resources, manage production, make deliveries, and expand your criminal empire together.

MASTER SIMULATED CROP GROWING

Create the right environment for every crop. Poor conditions can damage or destroy your harvest, while a carefully managed setup can produce valuable yields.

EXPLORE A LARGE OPEN WORLD

Travel through a large world. Secluded locations, establish hidden operations, purchase properties, make deliveries, and expand across long distances.

BUILD LEGITIMATE FRONTS

Purchase and operate legitimate businesses to launder money and divert police attention. Every business becomes part of your empire, but valuable properties can also attract the attention of rival gangs.

DRIVE, DELIVER, AND ESCAPE

Take control of more than 20 vehicles with physics-based handling. Transport supplies, move product, relocate equipment, and make a fast exit when a deal goes wrong.

A LIVING, SIMULATED WORLD

Custom large-scale traffic and NPC systems keep the world moving around you. Roads remain active, communities feel populated, and every journey presents new risks and opportunities.

TOP-DOWN COMBAT

Protect your operation when negotiation is no longer an option. Fight rival gangs, defend your properties, and survive the consequences of becoming known.

Radical Tower Defense

Defense is not the end goal—it is preparation for pushing behind enemy lines.

Radical Tower Defense is a single-player, 2D top-down strategy tower defense game. Build your defenses around the Signal Tower, then decide which structures deserve your investment, which enemies must be dealt with first, and when it is time to take the fight to the enemy.

Plan the Battlefield Around the Signal Tower

Choose the right positions for your defensive structures across the map. The Signal Tower determines your deployment range and serves as the core of your defensive line. Move it and adjust your defensive center to extend your firepower across a larger battlefield.

Spend gold to build, upgrade, sell, and reorganize your towers. Give each tower a clear role—careful combinations matter more than simply stacking raw power.

Redefine Your Towers with Chips

Equip your towers with Chips to change the way they attack and the roles they fulfill.

Piercing shots, spread fire, multi-shot attacks… Each Chip has its own compatibility requirements and slot restrictions.

Turn a tower into a long-range single-target weapon, or build a setup focused on area bombardment, damage over time, dense bullet barrages, or dangerous close-range traps. True strength comes from how your Chips work together.

Waves Will Pressure You from Multiple Fronts

Enemies will not approach from a single route. As the waves progress, multiple enemy spawn points will continue to produce different enemy compositions.

Will you hold your ground and steadily reinforce your firepower, or risk pushing into enemy territory? Every wave forces you to choose between “keep preparing” and “strike now.”

Understand Your Enemies to Push the Front Line

You will face enemies with different roles and abilities. Study their traits, then adjust your range, damage types, and defensive priorities to keep your line standing until the end.

If you enjoy tower defense games that reward careful planning, battlefield awareness, and constant experimentation, add Radical Tower Defense to your wishlist.

【Drift Factory】is an open-world, automated construction simulation game set in the vast ocean. The game offers a zero-to-zero experience of building an industrial empire at sea, providing players with an immersive journey of free creation, strategic planning, and hardcore character development.

Game Story and Background

On the boundless ocean, without land or any foothold, the entire sea holds unknown dangers and limitless development potential. Players drift alone on the vast ocean, with only a small, rudimentary floating platform as their sole foundation. In this perilous maritime world, there are no ready-made industrial systems or survival resources; all development, construction, and breakthroughs must be achieved through hands-on exploration. Starting from your tiny floating platform, you will withstand the unknown risks of the ocean, overcome resource scarcity, and gradually build a complete industrial system. From scratch, you will create your own maritime industrial empire, ultimately unlocking interstellar travel technology, building your own starship, traversing the deep sea and outer space, heading to Mars, and completing the ultimate transformation from sea survival to interstellar exploration.

Core Gameplay and Mechanics

The game revolves around four core gameplay elements: expanding offshore platforms, resource gathering, technology research, and building automated production lines. Players start with only a basic floating platform and simple tools, manually collecting initial resources to obtain the basic materials for survival and construction. As development progresses, players can freely expand their offshore platforms, organize construction areas, plan industrial layouts, and build a comprehensive conveyor belt logistics network connecting the entire process of mining, processing, synthesis, and production. The game features a complete technology unlocking system and automated production logic, allowing players to design their own production line layouts, optimize logistics routes, and integrate production processes, completely freeing players from manual operation and enabling fully automated resource mining, processing, storage, and production. This tests players' spatial planning abilities, resource management skills, and industrial layout strategies.

The game employs a unique mechanism design throughout, featuring modular platform construction, free-form logistics networking, and tiered technology unlocking. It abandons fixed production line templates, allowing players to completely customize their industrial production systems. By combining different technologies and equipment, players can create a unique offshore factory operation mode, making each construction plan a completely new experience and greatly enhancing the game's freedom and creativity.

Game Objectives and Challenges

The core gameplay objectives are clearly progressive: starting with basic maritime survival, resource gathering, and stabilizing floating platforms, players gradually progress through technological research, factory expansion, automation system construction, and the establishment of production lines for all types of resources. Ultimately, they conquer advanced aerospace technology, build their own starship, and unlock the ultimate ending of Mars exploration. The game features tiered challenges: the early game focuses on resource scarcity and platform stability; the mid-game tests industrial layout optimization and efficient production line operation; and the late game presents hardcore challenges involving advanced technology unlocking, complex equipment coordination, and starship construction, catering to both beginners and advanced players.

Meanwhile, the maritime world harbors various random crises and environmental challenges. The marine environment will continuously test platforms and factory facilities. Players need to constantly optimize defense systems, upgrade production equipment, and improve resource reserves to ensure the stable operation of the industrial system while dealing with maritime risks, safeguarding the long road to industrial development and interstellar exploration.

Sweden, 1986. Three years after the bombs.

You command a small convoy of battered vehicles crossing a frozen Scandinavia. Your crew is hungry, your fuel is low, and every road hides something — desperate refugees, armed gangs, Soviet patrols, or the irradiated ruins of cities that shouldn't have been hit.

A tactical roguelike of convoy survival


Every encounter offers a choice: fight in detailed turn-based vehicle combat — ramming, boarding, flanking through forests — or resolve it abstractly and keep moving. Tactical battles reward skill with captured vehicles and elite crew. Abstract battles save time but cost control. The choice defines your playstyle.

A real map of Scandinavia


107×209 tiles of hand-placed terrain based on real geography. Stockholm is a contested ruin. Göteborg's dockyards still trade. Kalmar glows. Kiruna hoards its secrets in the frozen north. 23 cities, each with their own factions, workshops, and stories to discover.

Systems that reward curiosity


  • Recruit survivors on the road — scouts, mechanics, politicians, hunters — each unlocking new options
  • Discover hidden bunkers, secret enclaves, and forgotten infrastructure through exploration
  • Tune in to radio chatter for cryptic hints about the world
  • Capture and upgrade vehicles at specialized workshops across the map
  • Control cities, garrison them, and defend them against raids
  • Multiple victory paths to discover — the game won't tell you what they are

No hand-holding


No quest markers. No minimap arrows. The game trusts you to read the radio, explore the map, and figure it out. Every playthrough reveals something new.

Built for modding


Every campaign, event, encounter, and balance value is an exposed JSON file. Drop a file in the mod folder — it loads automatically. Write new quest chains, rebalance combat, create factions, or add victory conditions. No code required. Full modding reference included.

TEAR THE SHIP APART.

Ragtag Fleet is a fast-paced pixel-destruction survival roguelite where enemy ships and battlefield structures are built to be broken.

Strip away armor pixel by pixel, carve open new firing lanes, expose critical Cores, and destroy the systems putting your fleet under pressure. Breaches remain, structures fall apart, and every scar changes how you move, aim, and survive.

BREAK. SALVAGE. BUILD. REPEAT.

Every wave feeds the next.

Tear through enemies and the environment to earn credits, then inspect a four-slot blueprint rack between battles. Lock, refresh, or pin the projects you want before crafting new weapons, drones, and modules for your growing formation.

Every addition changes more than a number. It changes the shape, reach, and destructive power of your fleet.

FIREPOWER CHANGES HOW YOU BREAK

Different weapons carve through pixel structures in different ways.

Machine guns cut steady breaches through exposed sections. Missiles blast open clusters of armor. Piercing weapons drill toward deeply buried Cores. Drones expand your firing coverage and turn a lone survivor into an improvised fleet.

Choose your tools, find the weak point, and decide whether to strike the Core or dismantle the entire ship.

FROM DESPERATE SURVIVAL TO OVERWHELMING FIREPOWER

Begin each run with limited firepower and fight through increasingly dangerous waves. Build a formation around your ship, survive hostile barrages and spatial hazards, then confront massive modular bosses that can be dismantled piece by piece.

A fragile opening can become a screen filled with weapons, explosions, drifting wreckage, and overwhelming firepower—if your build survives long enough to come together.

KEY FEATURES

  • Pixel-by-pixel destruction across enemy ships and battlefield structures

  • Targetable Cores that control enemy weapons, defenses, and movement

  • Persistent breaches and battle scars that reshape movement and firing lanes

  • Fast wave-based survival runs with escalating pressure and Boss encounters

  • A four-slot blueprint system with locking, refreshing, and pinning

  • Weapons, drones, and modules that visibly expand your fleet

  • Distinct destruction styles, from precision cutting to explosive demolition

  • A dramatic power curve from fragile survival to screen-clearing firepower

Break it apart. Build it back. Bring the firepower.

Lead the raid. Carry the consequences.

Raid Leader Simulator is a fantasy guild-management auto battler about building a team capable of clearing demanding raids. Recruit specialists, set weekly schedules, negotiate contracts, and prepare gear and tactics. Then start the pull and watch your roster fight real-time 3D boss encounters on its own.

BUILD A RAID TEAM

Recruit tanks, healers, melee fighters, ranged attackers, and specialists. Balance roles, individual strengths, availability, morale, and contracts as you shape an eight-player roster.

MANAGE THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE PARTY

Handle attendance problems, pay, loot promises, negotiations, and rival pressure. Your decisions affect trust, motivation, and whether your best raiders remain with the guild.

PREPARE EVERY ATTEMPT

Set formations, assign roles, choose tactical focus and pace, and plan a response to each boss mechanic before the pull. Learn boss patterns from combat reports and refine the plan for the next attempt.

WATCH YOUR PLAN PLAY OUT

Once the pull starts, your raiders fight automatically in real-time 3D, following the plan you set. Step in with a new call when a mechanic goes wrong, or sit back and see whether your preparation holds.

GROW TOWARD HARDER RAIDS

Improve gear, develop your roster, pursue hidden gates, and turn a struggling team into a guild ready for the season's biggest challenges.

A railway of your own

Rail Capital is a real-time railway strategy game about running trains and making money. You'll lay track, connect towns and work out which cargo is worth carrying. You'll also have shareholders, and some of them may fancy running your company themselves.

Start by founding a company and selling shares to pay for your first line. From there, the railway is yours to plan: pick a route across the hex map, bridge a river, or pay for a tunnel through the hills. Keep an eye on what the other companies are building, too.

Mind whose money you're spending

A profitable railway doesn't automatically make you rich. Its money belongs to the company. Keep the profits in the business and you can afford more track and better trains. Pay a dividend and some of that money reaches your own pocket, along with everyone else who owns shares.

You can buy into other railways as well. Overtake the president's shareholding and you can take their job, with their network to manage. Of course, someone can do the same to you. Mergers are another option when the conditions are right.

If you've played an 18xx board game, this tug of war between the railway and its shareholders will feel familiar. If you haven't, don't worry, it's not that tough!

Give your trains a reason to run

A mine needs a customer. A factory needs materials. Passengers need a way to get where they're going. Join them up with services that earn their keep, choosing what each carriage picks up and where it unloads. Warehouses let you gather cargo before sending it on, while factories give you finished goods to carry as well as raw materials.

Help fund the next factory

You can invest in industry as well as railways. Help fund a factory, then plan how to serve it. Supply and demand affect prices, so a route that looks promising today still needs watching. Public contracts, private deals and ports trading with distant markets give you more places to look for business.

Going once, going twice...

The auction house sells prototype locomotives, blueprints, company bonuses and freight consignments. Bidding happens in real time, with the other companies after the same lots. That blueprint might be worth stretching the budget for. Just remember what else you were saving up to buy.

The Iron Road

For a longer challenge, take a company through The Iron Road, a roguelite campaign of railway contests. Pick a branch on the route map and tackle its next contest, Railway Exchange or tougher rival challenge. Seeded maps and regional modifiers give you different conditions to work with.

Each contest starts with a fresh railway to build. Your company identity and the bonuses you've earned come with you, including improvements to revenue, train speed or construction costs. Win contests to add to your Rail Fund, then spend it at Railway Exchanges on more bonuses and reward rerolls.

You'll have to make those advantages work on each new map. Reach the final challenge and win it to complete the journey. Lose a contest and that run is over.

Pick your next game

Play against AI rivals with different personalities, or compete with other players in real-time multiplayer. There are seeded sandbox maps, handcrafted scenarios, guided campaigns and daily challenges. The level editor is there if you'd like to make your own.

The free demo is available now. Give it a go and see how your first company fares.

The wasteland is overrun, and the railway is your only way through.

Railhold is a top-down action roguelite tower defense built around an armored train. Add new wagons, mount weapons and put together a crew capable of keeping the train alive as enemies attack from every direction.

Most battles happen while the train is moving. Your defenses need to cover the entire convoy, and every wagon you add creates something new that must be protected. Place turrets on available hardpoints, upgrade important systems and use commander abilities when your defenses begin to buckle.

Stations give you a moment to repair, reorganize and prepare for what lies further down the line. Resources are limited, so you will have to decide which parts of the train are worth improving and which weaknesses you can afford to leave exposed.

Every run gives you different upgrades, encounters and opportunities to shape your convoy. Experiment with weapon combinations, recruit crew with useful abilities and adapt your strategy before the next horde—or something much larger—reaches the tracks.

Features:

  • Build and expand your own armored train

  • Defend the convoy during real-time battles

  • Mount, upgrade and combine different turret types and form over 45 different turret synergies. 

  • Recruit crew members to operate and strengthen the train

  • Make repairs and difficult upgrade choices at stations

  • Face increasingly dangerous mutants and massive bosses

  • Discover new builds through replayable roguelite runs

  • Keep the train moving for as long as you can

Build the train. Hold the line. Keep moving.

Start small. Mine bigger.

Railminer begins with a locomotive and a small drill. Your train works its way along a resource-rich rock face. After each run, sell your haul and invest the proceeds in new machines and upgrades.

Grow your train with every run

Expand your machinery with larger cutters, heavy breakers, lasers, rockets, and mining drones. Unlock new branches of the upgrade tree and choose where to spend your earnings: stronger tools, new wagons, or more fuel for your next run.

Mine. Sell. Upgrade.

  • Extract stone, copper, iron, silver, gold, and diamonds.
  • Watch a small drilling wagon grow into a whole train of mining machines.
  • See tools and impacts break apart the rock face, piece by piece.
  • Develop your train through a branching upgrade tree.

The towers are necessary, but they do not attack.

The 'Line' connecting the towers becomes your weapon.

Draw lines of six different colors in the right places to suppress the waves of incoming monsters.

- Draw lines to block the enemy's path.

  • When you connect two towers, a line of the same color is created.

  • You can attack monsters of the same color. If the tower colors are different, a line that combines both colors is created. Since this line has half of each color, the damage is also halved.

- Equip the most necessary lines in the 6 color slots.

  • Before the stage begins, place the lines you need into the color slots.

  • If a Spiral Line is equipped in the red color slot, the red line will be installed as a Spiral Line when placed.

  • Every line has unique skills. For example, the Spiral Line confuses monsters, and the Bomb Line performs an area-of-effect (AoE) attack.

- Strategically rebuild towers with the colors you need most.

  • You can rebuild towers at any time. Rebuild them with colors that suit your strategic hotspots.

  • Depending on the terrain, the most necessary color for that spot changes every time.

- Upgrade the towers in the most critical locations to be the most powerful.

  • The stronger the tower, the stronger the connected lines become.

  • You can improve the tower's attack power, durability, and the number and length of its connected lines.

  • Reinforcing the towers in the most important positions is an essential requirement for victory.

Key Points

  • 'Line Connection' System: In Rainbow Tower Defense, towers do not attack. You attack using the 'lines' connected to the towers.

  • Strategic Combination of 6 Colors: Infinite strategic depth is hidden within the intuitive rules of color matching, mixing, and connecting.

  • A Test of Reflexes and Decisiveness: Meticulous strategic choices tailored to monster combinations, the decisiveness to overcome crises at any moment, and the reflexes to respond to each wave of incoming monsters are the keys to victory.

The souls within you are your vital essence. But which ones are you willing to sacrifice to face your destiny?

Raise, Rise & Die is a dark fantasy deckbuilder where your cards are also your life. Play as one of four humans brought back to life, choose your weapons, and fight with the souls you have absorbed. Face the dangers together with two-player co-op in Arena and the Ancients’ Path.

Four ways to play, alone or with a friend

  • Arena: a run against the AI, tier by tier. Every tier ends with a Guardian announced from the start: build your deck to beat it.

  • Duel: the same fights against another player, online, with matchmaking and an Elo ranking.

  • Ancients' Path: build your own runs, down to the monsters and what their cards do. A run can only be published once you've beaten it, then it's shared as a six-character code.

  • Aventure : travel a map from place to place and carry what you find back into your fights.

  • Co-op: the Arena and the Ancients' Path can also be played by two, online.

ARENA — LEARN TO ASSESS THE DANGER

Fight your way through solo encounters against monsters with automated decks. Choose your next opponent from three options, earn cards, and develop your deck throughout the run.

At rest, every reward brings a new dilemma: keep a card for what it adds to your strategy, or sacrifice it to recover HP. A card you give up today might be sorely missed a few fights later.

Your deck size determines your maximum health. But survival is about more than collecting cards: you need to build a deck that works together, choose your battles, and know when to take a risk.

Find powerful synergies, push your score higher, and compete on the leaderboard. The run ends when you fall.

Take on the Arena together. Play solo or team up with another player for a cooperative run.

ONE CARD, MANY POSSIBILITIES

A single Soul Value serves three purposes: a card’s cost, the Reserve it generates when sacrificed from your hand, and the HP you lose when it falls as your Top Soul.

The Top Soul is the face-up card on top of your deck during combat. When damage causes it to fall, you lose HP equal to its Soul Value. Excess damage can reach the cards beneath it, triggering a cascade.

You can see both your Top Soul and your opponent’s. That information shapes how you attack, defend, and prepare your next move.

Sacrifice cards from your hand to build your Reserve, then spend it to play the others. Keep an option open or fund your attack: the choice is yours.

And your opponent can respond. Blocks, counters, and retaliations can turn an exchange you thought you had under control.

ANCIENTS’ PATH — LEVEL EDITOR

Become an Ancient and forge your own path.

Choose the opponents, rules, and starting deck. Customize monsters and cards, down to their stats, effects, and appearance. Combine the game’s building blocks to create a challenge of your own.

But before sharing it with other players, you must complete a validation run yourself. Then seal your path: your score becomes the benchmark to beat.

Discover other players’ paths, take on their challenges, and compare your results on each path’s dedicated leaderboard.

The editor is included in the game. No additional purchase required.

Take on the challenges of the Ancients’ Path solo or together in two-player co-op.

THREE GAME MODES AND A LEVEL EDITOR!

Arena

Solo or two-player co-op runs, a deck that evolves with each reward, and a score to beat.

Duel

Build your deck around your character and weapons, then face another player online, with matchmaking and Elo rankings.

Adventure — in development, planned for Early Access

Travel across a map, discover illustrated locations, and encounter events tied to the world and its characters. Another way to explore the world of Raise, Rise & Die.

Ancients’ Path

Create your own challenges and take on those made by other players, solo or in two-player co-op.

PHYSICAL CARDS BEFORE THE VIDEO GAME

The combat rules were designed and playtested with physical cards for two and a half years before being adapted into a video game.

Developed solo, Raise, Rise & Die stays true to its tabletop roots: cards with multiple uses, decisions that commit your resources, and an opponent who can respond to your moves.

The engine handles the calculations and resolves the effects. The decisions remain yours.
Solo developed, in dark pixel art finished by hand. The art is AI-generated as a starting point, then reworked and integrated by hand.

Rally Point is a real-time strategy game where you play cards and your army does the fighting. Battles are a few minutes long and a campaign run takes a few hours.


You build a squad of 3 heroes, 3 mechs and 4 support cards out of more than 90 options. Supply refills over time, and the more control points you hold the faster it comes in. You can spend it on cheap units right away or save up for something big, like a Gunship to clear a point or a Nuke when a lane is going badly.




Units pick their own targets and fight on their own, so there's no micro. What you decide is where things go and when to commit. If a lane starts slipping you can re-rally a hero over to it. In solo battles you can hit HOLD at any time to stop the clock, look over the field and line up your next card. Each AI difficulty level has its own named commander, and beating that level unlocks them. After that you can hand them your side in any PvE battle and take control back whenever you want. In solo you can speed things up while they play.




Each campaign run starts with a draft and a new galaxy split between rival factions. Every faction has its own commander, and they don't sit still between your missions. They reinforce, counterattack your sectors and fight each other for ground. You can scout a mission to counter-pick what's coming, or take a blind fight for better upgrades. Play it solo or with a friend in co-op, and there's an Ironman mode where losses can remove units from your squad.

There's also the Frontier War, a seasonal war between the five factions. You pick a side and the battles you play count toward its push on a shared map, so if you beat a K'tharr commander in your campaign the K'tharr front gives a bit. Your own faction never shows up as an enemy in your games. Campaign, co-op, quick battles and ranked all count. Each season runs for a calendar month and the rewards are just cosmetic.




Battles play out across a range of biomes, from desert outposts and lava fields to asteroid rock. Outside the campaign you can host custom rooms for 1v1, 2v2 or a four-player free-for-all, mark a match as ranked to get on the leaderboard, and make your own maps in the map editor for campaign or custom games.



  • Real-time lane battles with no unit micro
  • 90+ hero, mech and support cards to build a 10-card squad from
  • Roguelite campaign, solo or online co-op, with an optional Ironman mode
  • Enemy factions that keep moving and counterattacking between missions
  • Frontier War: pick one of five factions and fight a shared seasonal war
  • HOLD to stop the clock in solo battles
  • Unlockable AI commanders you can hand a battle over to
  • 1v1, 2v2 and free-for-all custom rooms with ranked leaderboards
  • Map editor

Who is the true G.O.A.T. of the arena? Build your dream fighting beast, charge at full speed, and launch your friends across the map in this wildly fun, physics-driven fighting game!

Welcome to Ram Fights — the wildest, most physics-defying animal brawler you’ve ever seen! Forget traditional martial arts; it's time to settle things the old-fashioned way: by sprinting headfirst into your problems.

Will you rely on the annoying lightning speed of a rooster, the balanced strikes of a mountain ram, or the pure, crushing mass of a giant yak? Build your beast, step into the arena, and let the chaos begin!

Key Features:

  • Hilarious Ragdoll Chaos: Feel the impact of every heavy hit! Land a perfect charge attack and watch your opponents get knocked off their hooves, flying across the arena with incredibly satisfying and funny ragdoll physics.

  • Build Your Ultimate Beast: Pimp your fighter! Equip nasty horns for extra damage, stylish wool patterns for armor, or flashy accessories. But choose wisely: a heavy, armored ram hits like a truck but runs out of breath fast!

  • Tactical Headbutts: It’s not just mindless button-mashing. Manage your stamina, dodge incoming attacks, stun your enemy, and unleash devastating kinetic-energy-fueled charges when they least expect it.

  • Epic Solo Campaign: Start from humble farmyard brawls and fight your way to the top. Complete crazy challenges and face off against massive, mythical boss animals that will test all your skills.

  • Multiplayer Mayhem: Prove who the real boss is! Climb the PvP ranked ladder, team up in Co-op, or invite your friends to private matches and smash them!

  • Interactive Arenas: Fight in snowy plains, narrow village corridors, and legendary rings. Use the environment to corner your rivals and deliver the final, crushing blow.

🍜🃏 Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder.

You're a hitman who left the Family — and a rookie ramen-stall owner.

Push your toppings to their limits, then rev them up even further with skills.

Build the ultimate Topping deck.

Master countless synergies and serve bowls so good they're synapse-frying.

Chase the one bowl that will cut you free from your past.

Gameplay

A simple game about plating toppings on your ramen.

Each topping card carries effects tied to three attributes: Trend, Fullness, and Refinement.

Trigger the coroutines (skills) you've installed at just the right moment to serve up something even more delicious.

At the shop, you can swap out toppings, or buy and upgrade coroutines.

↑He's N3CO-3 — folks call him Neko-san — owner of this ramen chain and your business-support AI. A sharp, capable operator.

Fail to satisfy the gourmet customer who shows up at the end of each stage, and it's straight back to the Family for you.

Survive ten honest days of business, and you'll finally win your freedom.

Story

You've left the Family behind to finally open the ramen stand you'd always dreamed of.

Now an old friend from the Family has turned up — sent to bring you back.

Win her over with a truly delicious bowl of ramen.

↑She's Yura — your old friend from long before the Family. Just like you, she's a lethal assassin.

Features

  • New toppings, coroutines, and 8 difficulty levels unlock with every clear

  • Simple, intuitive rules

  • An anime-inspired art style in harmony with the game's systems

Over 20 toppings and over 20 coroutines offer a wide variety of playstyles.

Build a ramen piled high with ice cream, or go for a one-shot kill with premium chashu — the choice is yours.

Now — time to open your stand.

Rank Risk: Guess the Order is a fast-paced trivia ranking game about knowledge, deduction, and risk management.

Each round gives you six answer cards and one clear goal: place them in the correct order. The question may ask you to rank animals, foods, inventions, or other surprising topics from lowest to highest, oldest to newest, weakest to strongest, and more.

SET YOUR RISK

Before every question, choose how much RP you want to risk. Play safe with a small risk, aim higher for a bigger reward, or go for Max Risk and put everything on the line.

But guessing is only half of the game.

RANK THE CARDS

When your order is wrong, the game tells you how many cards are in the correct position — not which ones. Use each attempt carefully, read the feedback, rethink the order, and try to solve the puzzle before your attempts run out.

GROW YOUR RP

Win questions to grow your RP, build streaks for bonus payouts, and chase your best score on the leaderboards.

Someone Comes to Entrust a Memory Again Today

Beyond the counter of a small pawnshop, a different customer walks in every day.

Some are in a hurry, some are cautious, and some say strangely little.

What they leave behind is one old object, and a hazy memory tied to it.

Listen, Doubt, and Ask Again

Conversations with customers are not fixed question-and-answer exchanges. LLM-based NPCs respond with their own personalities, circumstances, and moods.

Look for clues in what the customers say.

You must figure out why they want to pawn the item, how clear their memory is, and whether there is anything they are not telling you.

But if you dig too deeply, the customer may grow uncomfortable. If you trust them too easily, you may end up offering the wrong price.

Value Is Not Only What You Can See

Use the magnifying glass to examine an item’s scratches and materials, and use the appraisal device to organize information that affects its price.

Or use the memory tuner to increase the value of a memory.

Sometimes customers may be mistaken, and sometimes they may be lying on purpose. To get close to the true value, you will need to use both your tools and your conversations.

Between a Good Deal and a Risky One

Offer too low a price, and the customer may walk out of the shop.

Offer too high a price, and your immediate profit may grow, but so will the chance that the item is never reclaimed.

Choose whether to make stable deals at fair prices, or take risks in pursuit of greater profit.

Even after a deal is made, the work is not over. Storage fees accumulate, and the condition of both items and memories gradually deteriorates. If you fail to manage what has been entrusted to you, your next deal will become even harder.

Buy Ingredients, Grow Them, and Brew Potions

The work does not end when the transaction is over.

Buy the ingredients you need from the shop, plant seeds, and grow them yourself. You may even obtain unexpected ingredients during deals.

Combine the ingredients you collect to brew potions. Potions can restore the quality of stored items or bring clarity back to fading memories.

Or perhaps they may be used to recover the protagonist’s forgotten memories.

Reputation Builds Quietly, and Falls Quietly

Satisfying transactions raise the shop’s reputation.

As your reputation improves, customers enter the shop in slightly better moods.

But if you upset a customer or reject deals carelessly, your reputation will fall.

Making money, or remaining a good shop.

For 30 days, you must find the balance between the two.

After 30 Days, What Will You Remember?

As you continue making deals, unusual objects begin to find their way into the shop.

These objects are not simple merchandise, but keys leading to forgotten stories.

Appraise customers’ memories, store their belongings, and protect the shop.

And over 30 days, follow the story of the protagonist as it gradually comes to light.
